snippet.title: A.O.T 3 - Gameplay Video ②: Exploration within the Walls
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://www.koeitecmoeurope.com/aot3/uk/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=Gameplay2UK&utm_id=Caption

A.O.T. 3 is coming to PlayStation®5, Nintendo Switch™ 2, XBOX Series X|S and Steam® on 10th December 2026.

Pre-order or wishlist now: 
https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/A-O-T-3-3231929.html
https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10012189
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2916700/Attack_on_Titan_3__AOT_3/
https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/productid/9n79r5gt8q6t

Begin – for the Farewell

A.O.T. 3 is the riveting culmination of the action game series, depicting the story of Attack on Titan from its Scout Regiment beginnings to its dramatic conclusion.

The opening animation for the game* will be produced by MAPPA, the animation studio that worked on Attack on Titan: The Final Season, with action scene animator, storyboard artist, and key animator Arifumi Imai returning as director. Stay tuned for more information and future reveals!
* The opening animation movie will not be implemented at the time of release but will be added to the game in a future update.
